item.title: Portrait Cut for Two Speakers

turns.text: Turn this into a 9:16 vertical clip. Show the man when he asks his question, then the woman when she answers, with each centred while talking. Keep all 10 seconds and the original audio. No captions.

item.tests: Tests speaker-aware portrait reframing of a two-person conversation without losing either speaking turn.

answer_sheet.Source and speakers: Use talk-two.mp4. The man asks the question and the woman answers.
answer_sheet.Layout and transitions: Centre the current speaker in a full-frame portrait crop; a clean cut at the speaker change is fine.
answer_sheet.Size and duration: 9:16 vertical, all 10 seconds; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Audio and text: Preserve the original conversation and sound, with no captions or added text.

must_haves: The output is a 9:16 portrait edit of the attached office conversation.
The man is centred and his face is fully visible during his question.
The woman is centred and her face is fully visible during her answer.
Both speaking turns remain in their original order, with the full 10 seconds and original audio in sync.
The image is not stretched and contains no added captions.

turns.text: Turn this into a 9:16 vertical clip. Show the man when he asks his question, then the woman when she answers, with each centred while talking. Keep all 10 seconds and the original audio. No captions.

dialog.agent:
I can’t make this exact edit with the connected Magic Hour tools. They offer generative video editing, but no precise crop-and-cut controls to guarantee speaker-centred framing while preserving all 10 seconds and the original audio unchanged.

In a standard video editor, the edit would be:
- Set the canvas to **9:16**.
- Centre the man during his question, then cut to a crop centred on the woman as she answers.
- Keep the full **10-second timeline** and original audio track untouched.
- Export with **no captions**.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

turns.agent:
The free-settings attempt was refused because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No clip was generated.

You’ll need additional credits to try the edit in Magic Hour, or use a local video editor for the 9:16 speaker-centred crops while keeping all 10 seconds and the original audio unchanged.

approvals.name: edit_video

style.prompt: Reframe this existing conversation into a 9:16 vertical portrait clip. Preserve the entire original 10-second timeline with no trimming, speed changes, reordering, or added scenes. Show the man centred in the vertical frame when he asks his question; switch the crop to the woman centred in the vertical frame when she answers. Match each crop switch to the actual speaker turn in the supplied video. Preserve the original people, appearance, scene, mouth movements and actions; only change framing as needed. Keep the original audio unchanged and in sync, including all dialogue and background sound. No generated speech, replacement audio, music, captions, subtitles, text, graphics, or overlays.
